summary: validateApp now requires non-empty owner (shared-contracts 2.0.0). core-shell(platform), billing(payments), reports(insights; also a caller, not in ticket) pass owner from package.json team; shipped in mono PR #1, CI+CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts is an in-repo lib inlined at build and no app depends on the registry copy, so no dependency adoption/lockfile change was needed and one PR was safe. PLAT-103-4 (platform-kit): it does not call validateApp or depend on shared-contracts, so no change made.
